recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed unless HL7 changes the canonical fhir-issues change-request URL or the Basic code-request process.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Basic clarification asking the spec to say where implementers should submit a request for a new HL7-defined Basic resource-type code; the resolution was to reference the gForge create-task page.
initial_application: Commit bf678c897caf7811032a8d9ebce3f2360252bd4e (#7400 - provide a change link) added a Basic best-practices Propose-a-change link to the old gForge tracker. Commit dbd08df53eb122db3a7accbc4ac47e87ad999c36 later changed that target to http://hl7.org/fhir-issues as part of the gForge/Jira transition.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists basic=Basic, and source/basic/basic-notes.xml currently tells implementers to submit new HL7 vocabulary type requirements using the Propose a change link. Quoted FHIR-7400 Zulip and Confluence searches found no later community evidence that reverses or narrows the applied guidance; broader Basic/new-code hits were unrelated.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current active Basic source already answers where to submit the request, using the maintained FHIR issue/change-request entry point rather than the obsolete gForge URL named in the 2015 resolution.
